criteria.criterion: scripts/lib/wordcount.sh defines a function wordcount that reads its first argument and prints the number of whitespace-separated words to stdout.
criteria.evidence: scripts/lib/wordcount.sh:3-5 — `wordcount() { printf '%s\n' "${1-}" | awk '{ count += NF } END { print count + 0 }' }` reads "$1" (defaulting safely under set -u via ${1-}) and prints the word count to stdout.

criteria.criterion: Behaviour: leading/trailing whitespace is ignored; consecutive whitespace counts as one separator; an empty or all-whitespace string counts as 0.
criteria.evidence: scripts/lib/wordcount.sh:4 — awk's NF splits on runs of whitespace and ignores leading/trailing whitespace by definition; for empty/all-whitespace input NF is 0 and `print count + 0` in the END block coerces the unset accumulator to 0. Pinned by tests/wordcount.sh:19-21 ('  a   b c  ' -> 3, '' -> 0), which the orchestrator reports as passing.

criteria.criterion: tests/wordcount.sh sources the helper and asserts: 'hello world' -> 2; '  a   b c  ' -> 3; '' -> 0.
criteria.evidence: tests/wordcount.sh:5 `source scripts/lib/wordcount.sh`; lines 19-21: `assert_wordcount 'hello world' '2'`, `assert_wordcount '  a   b c  ' '3'`, `assert_wordcount '' '0'`.

criteria.criterion: tests/wordcount.sh exits 0 when all assertions pass.
criteria.evidence: tests/wordcount.sh:2 `set -euo pipefail` aborts non-zero on any failed assertion (assert_wordcount returns 1 on mismatch, line 17); when all pass, the final assert_wordcount returns 0 and the script exits 0. Orchestrator evidence: 'all 23 required tests executed and passed'.

reasons: All four acceptance criteria are MET with direct evidence in the diff: the wordcount function exists at the specified path, awk NF semantics satisfy the whitespace behavior requirements including the empty-string -> 0 case via `count + 0`, and the test file sources the helper and asserts exactly the three required cases.
tests/wordcount.sh uses set -euo pipefail with an assert helper that returns non-zero on mismatch, so it exits 0 iff all assertions pass; orchestrator evidence confirms all 23 required tests passed.
Changed paths are exactly the two in_scope files (both new), with no scope drift, no regression surface, and no security concerns.
